text_block_list.text: Taiki! You ready?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm ready when you are!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Then let's get that gate open!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: On your marks... Get set...
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Go!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Patter, patter, patter!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса and Тайки Шаттл both
take off
running down the road out in
front of the dorms.
What are those two
up to?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew! Perfect! That should do the trick!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! No problemo! Dinner's gonna be
luxurious
tonight!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл
choice_data_list: What are you two up to?

text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Well see, there's an event
goin' on
right now at a popular cafe for
their new pizza!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
They're only 500 yen! And not just the
small
ones—the extra-large ones too!
First come, first
served! Plus, there's no
limit to how many you can
buy!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That's why me and El are trainin'
together. We're
gonna treat ourselves to
some extra-larges!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
They're so big, it's gonna take both of us
just to
carry them back!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You can come with if you want, Trainer!
What do
you think?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
If the three of us go, we can carry way
more in
one trip!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Now that's thinkin'! Let's have ourselves a lil' extra-large pizza shindig!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Before I can grasp the situation, the two
take me
with them to the cafe.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: We're here! The place is over there!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wow! It sure is packed!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
There's way more people than I thought!
We
should've made a plan!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: Just stroll up like you own the place!
Look for a gap in the crowd!

text_block_list.text:
There's way more people than I thought!
We
should've made a plan!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: Just stroll up like you own the place!
Look for a gap in the crowd!

text_block_list.text:
Like we own the place? Oh, I see! It's all
about
attitude!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Oh! That sounds kinda fun!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
No hay problema! I'm Эль Кондор Паса!
Hella
strong, hella fast, hella
intimidating!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm goin' all out too! Hehe, I'm so
ready!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: They're about to open! Let's go, Taiki!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Let's nab us a big'un!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Taking care not to bump into anyone,
we move
forward like we belong at the
front. A bit later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Got one! Extra-large, babyyy!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You want us to slip through the gaps?! I
see! So
this needs some finesse!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Yeah, I think you're exactly right!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
We gotta be extra careful! It could be
bad if we
were to accidentally bump into
anyone!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
I go all out when I'm runnin' at practice,
but we
can't push our way through here!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Understood, Trainer! Leave it to me! I'm
the
world's strongest, after all!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure it gets done! Let's go,
Taiki!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm all set too! Time to nab us a big ol'
pizza!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса makes her way forward,
carefully
weaving her way through the
crowd in pursuit of
pizza!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Got one! Extra-large, babyyy!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Her powerful voice resonates through
the air.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems like Эль Кондор Паса may have
learned
something while weaving
skillfully through the
crowd to get pizza.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
